items.t: Overheating from a failed cooling fan
items.note: One owner paid about $1,013 for the fan housing; CarComplaints lists a typical total around $1,580.

items.t: No heat or HVAC controls act up
items.note: RepairPal estimates $1,170 to $1,546 because the dash must come apart; some actuators are easier to reach.
CarComplaints lists an average owner cost of about $1,000.

items.t: Retractable hardtop won't open or close
items.job: Body control system diagnosis for the folding top
items.note: RepairPal lists $49 to $72 for diagnosis. Top motors, sensors or a module cost extra.

RepairPal lists electrical diagnosis at $122 to $179. Rebuilding the gauge motors or replacing the cluster costs more; one CarComplaints owner spent about $2,500 on several electrical repairs including the cluster.

items.t: Low beams and daytime lights suddenly go out
items.job: Diagnose headlamp circuit and driver module
items.note: RepairPal lists electrical diagnosis at $122 to $179. Ask a dealer about any recall or special coverage first.
RepairPal lists electrical diagnosis at $122 to $179. A new actuator is extra.

items.t: Transmission slips, loses gears or loses drive
items.note: RepairPal lists general diagnosis at $122 to $179. A rebuild or replacement costs much more.

items.t: Buzz or squawk from the automatic transmission
items.job: Check transmission fluid level and diagnose noise
items.note: RepairPal lists general diagnosis at $122 to $179.

items.t: ABS light on from a bad brake module ground
items.job: Brake system inspection and ABS code read
items.note: RepairPal lists $122 to $179 for the inspection and $207 to $291 if a wheel speed sensor is needed.
RepairPal estimates $73 to $107 for adjustment. Resurfacing the drums or new shoes costs more.

items.t: Blower motor dead, stuck on or noisy
items.job: Diagnose blower motor and its control module
items.note: RepairPal lists electrical diagnosis at $122 to $179. Parts are extra.

items.t: Door-ajar light, window or alarm acts up
items.job: Diagnose door switches and window indexing
items.note: RepairPal lists electrical diagnosis at $122 to $179.

items.t: No-start with theft codes P1626 or P1631
items.note: RepairPal lists $61 to $90. Module reprogramming is extra.
